execution.live_capture: physical Linux host; digest-pinned MySQL 8 / Memcached 1.6 on owned internal Docker networks
execution.toolchain: Rust 1.98 in a temporary two-CPU/four-GiB Linux build container
execution.mysql_authentication: isolated disposable mysql_native_password fixture, not a production authentication recommendation
execution.exclusion_reason: dev-1 reproduced MySQL misclassification; dev-2/3 failed Memcached slab-limit startup configuration; dev-4 reproduced Memcached misclassification/missed NOT_STORED. None count toward acceptance.

mysql.kind: real server response and actual packet-derived package stage
mysql.fix: Require 1045/#28000 for authentication denial; require command-response sequence 1 and complete ERR prefix for query errors

memcached.kind: real server response with per-candidate cross-check failures
package_failures: data package protocols/memcached/get/main.gewy phase receive_value: observed {}, expected {8241, 8242}; check packet candidates versus framed response
data package protocols/memcached/set/main.gewy phase receive_stored: observed {}, expected {8241, 8242}; check packet candidates versus framed response
data package protocols/memcached/not-stored/main.gewy phase receive_not_stored: observed {}, expected {8241}; check packet candidates versus framed response
fixes: GET value requires status zero and four-byte flags extras
NOT_STORED status 5 includes APPEND/PREPEND as well as legacy SET alternative

verification.scope: Gewyvern library and five targeted integration suites, plus native validation and status catalog closure suites; not a whole-workspace test or release gate

cleanup.note: Before/after campaign inventories are identical; final inventory then removes only the temporary build container. PostgreSQL/Redis control is separate from MySQL/Memcached totals.

limitations: single physical host/kernel; not cross-host qualification
plaintext test fixtures, no TLS decryption
no arbitrary protocol detection or vulnerability-exploitation claim
bounded complete server-stream oracle, not general TCP reassembly
no request payload capture or PID/container-process attribution
MySQL protocol 4.1 direct native-password only, no caching-SHA2/auth switch/compression/prepared/extended results
Memcached binary only; no text/meta/SASL/UDP or caching-policy certification
not a high-load benchmark, leak test or release artifact
